summary: Iter-27 OPERATIVE PASS full E2E — backend (11 pytest tests, 100% pass) + frontend Playwright (dashboard, missions, subscribe flow, confetti modal, nav badge, mobile overflow, auth-benefit scroll fix). All 16 review requirements verified.

integration_issues.flow: Navbar tier badge after in-session subscribe
integration_issues.issue: nav-tier-badge only appears after a hard reload — Navbar.jsx fetches api.mySubscription() once on mount and does not re-fetch after the user activates a paid tier via the /subscribe → tier-up-celebration flow. Functional after reload but not real-time. Minor.

action_items: OPTIONAL/MINOR: Make Navbar re-fetch mySubscription after successful subscribe (e.g., emit a window event from Subscribe.jsx or expose a setTier via context) so nav-tier-badge appears immediately without a hard reload.
critical_code_review_comments: tiers.py is the single source of truth — good. Consider exporting price/quota constants for tests so the test file does not duplicate magic numbers.
POST /api/me/subscribe: unknown tier_id silently falls back to rookie via get_tier() and then 400s with 'rookie' message — acceptable but a 400 with 'Unknown tier' would be clearer.
GET /api/me/dashboard does an `await db.list_collection_names()` per request (line 4516) just to decide whether to count recovery_cases — costly. Use try/except on count_documents instead.
/me/missions is static (_DAILY_MISSIONS in-memory) — fine for ship-today but flagged for future quest engine.
Navbar.jsx fetches tier only on mount → stale until reload after subscribe (see integration issue above).

Frontend testids verified: dashboard-hero/name/quote/stats, stat-orders/recovery/wallet/tools, dashboard-quick-actions, qa-smm/recovery/tools/wallet, dashboard-missions, mission-{id}/-claim/-claimed, dashboard-pass-card, dashboard-orders, dashboard-referral, dashboard-library, tier-badge, streak-fire, tier-expiry, subscribe-hero/wallet-bar/current-tier/tier-grid, sub-tier-{rookie/operative/shadow/ghost}, sub-cta-{tier_id}, tier-up-celebration, tier-up-dismiss, nav-tier-badge (appears only after reload following subscribe). Auth-benefit mobile bugfix verified: /login click scrolls 108→95, /signup click scrolls 662→95, desktop click is no-op (0→0).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Only one minor UX gap: Navbar's tier badge is fetched once on mount; after the user subscribes via /subscribe → tier-up-celebration → /me, the badge appears only after a full reload. Root cause: Navbar.jsx useEffect runs once with empty deps and there is no global tier-state subscription. Mitigation (P3): dispatch a CustomEvent('eh:tier-changed') from Subscribe.jsx and listen for it in Navbar, OR move tier state into a React context provider.
